response.sql:
WITH obs_telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    SUM(telescope_count) OVER () as total
  FROM obs_telescope_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / total as share,
    AVG(CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / total) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM with_totals
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as difference_from_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories that have at least one telescope (appearing in the telescopes table) are included when calculating the average share. Observatories in the observatories table with zero telescopes are excluded. The average share across observatories is calculated as 1 / (number of observatories with telescopes).

alternatives.interpretation: If 'all observatories' means all observatories in the observatories table (including those with zero telescopes), include observatories with no assigned telescopes in the average share calculation via LEFT JOIN.
